Scope Gate.decided_by: CEO vuhoangcao (recorded by the orchestrator session)
Scope Gate.rationale: CEO approved the scope (attempt 3: S-001..S-014, A-001..A-040) with its defaults in chat on 2026-10-26, recorded as CEO-D-1307; CEO-D-1306 answers the four former blocking questions; Q-001 answered by CEO-D-1307 item 2 (an employee operator may record in their own real voice).

Planning Gate.decided_by: orchestrator (MC-16 session, on the CEO's Scope Gate approval, CEO-D-1307)
Planning Gate.rationale: The plan (23 tasks in 13 waves, risks R-001 to R-014) covers every approved scope item S-001 to S-014 with traceability, puts the RK-016 vertical-render proof (T-006) before the composition work, keeps all tests offline with code-generated fixtures, adds no download and touches neither the frozen waves nor the company store. Q-001 is answered: qa-owned checks run inside quality-review. Q-002 stays conditional on T-006.

Design Gate.decided_by: CEO (owner), recorded by the orchestrator: decision record entry 1308
Design Gate.rationale: The CEO approved the design with safe areas: ffmpeg-only 1080x1920 composition with no browser and no socket, a separate .NET tool outside the company store, a hash-chained ledger file outside the repository. Additions: captions and the AI-and-affiliate overlay sit inside a phone-screen safe area clear of the right-hand action buttons and the bottom description, at a size readable on a phone; the browser-drawn caption plate fallback with loopback sockets only is allowed ahead of time if the proof frame fails; clip and recording lengths may differ by at most 0.5 s. Design questions: Q-001 yes (the installed media tool is the delivered render tool), Q-002 no exemption beyond the held one (override sentence path), Q-004 configured digests stand, Q-006 yes (an unimplemented port interface is not a speech component), Q-007 yes (CEO Part E review).

Review Gate.decided_by: orchestrator for qa (the reviewer produced the findings; producer exclusion)
Review Gate.rationale: Second review: all twelve first-round correction requests verified closed against code and tests, no critical or high finding open, build 0 warnings and 251 of 251 pilot tests re-run and confirmed by the reviewer. Two low findings stay open and non-blocking, carried to the release note as known limitations: the first-person list refuses overrides containing 'em' or 'anh' (for example 'em bé', 'tiếng Anh'), and the package's ledger-entry copy is written non-atomically.

Verification Gate.rationale: Executed evidence: pilot unit 216/216 and integration 35/35 (reviewer re-ran 251/251), the existing non-Docker suites at baseline, and an end-to-end sample from generated fixtures only. The orchestrator independently re-measured the sample video: SHA-256 c13e81d43bc6cbf0ba5d94712b5cf90e2e467312b829d04cb02801b75abd3c29, h264 1080x1920 with aac audio, 17.4 s; frame at 0.8 s shows the overlay and a disclosure caption page inside the safe area; checklist pre-ticks only B8, with B3 and B5 left for the CEO per decision record entry 1309. Refusals demonstrated: banned term, recording over 60 s, reused recording, landscape clip, clip length mismatch, caption page too short, non-plain package file, void approval, hash mismatch. Zero sockets owned by job processes. No media file added to the repository.

Closure Gate.rationale: Every phase completed and every gate decided: Scope, Planning, Design (CEO, decision record entries 1307 and 1308), Review (rejected once, corrected under entry 1309, then approved), Verification. The release note passed validation on attempt 2 and records 16 known issues and 9 open questions with owners. Code is committed in fc21199 and e264a7a; the branch push and the compare link to the CEO follow as the closing action. Nothing publishes; the CEO approves each video by hash.
